technical_summary: Workload types: real-time agent_assist (short responses), ticket_summarization (post-call), tool_calling to internal ticketing APIs
Model preferences: open-models preferred; pilot with 4-bit quantized Llama-variant chat models + fallback smaller model (distilled) during spikes
Routing/fallback: require automated fallback policy (model variant + region/failover) and warm standby nodes for predictable cold-start behavior
Caching: strong interest in prefix/KV caching for repeated KB queries and conversation context reuse
Performance SLOs: p95 < 500ms for simple completions, p99 < 1.2s; sustained throughput 2k rpm, spike handling to 12k rpm for 30-120 minute windows
Backpressure strategy: queue backpressure with graceful degrade (summaries only, async ticket creation), rate-based throttles, and routed fallback to cheaper region or model
Observability: token-level latency/cost, per-route tracing, and alerts on quality regressions tied to prompt sets
Compliance: require audit logging, retention controls, and KMS integration for customer-managed keys
